items.title: The limiting page of the spectral sequence and the associated graded of the cohomology
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that when the limiting terms of the spectral sequence of a filtered differential object exist, the limiting page is graded by Z_inf^p/B_inf^p and the associated graded of the cohomology is a graded subquotient of it (statement lines 6058-6069). The proof is a complete argument: the degree p parts of Z_inf and B_inf are identified as displayed intersections and unions, using the construction of the spectral sequence and an elementary argument about graded subobjects (proof lines 6072-6092); two displayed inclusions exhibit the kernel over the image as a subquotient of the limiting page (proof lines 6094-6115); and the comparison with the definition of the filtration on cohomology closes the argument (proof lines 6115-6119). The non-formal content is the bookkeeping with intersections and unions of graded subobjects. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
